text.7:16: He said: Now, because Thou hast sent me astray, verily I shall lurk in ambush for them on Thy Right Path.
text.11:34: My counsel will not profit you if I were minded to advise you, if Allah's will is to keep you astray. He is your Lord and unto Him ye will be brought back.
text.15:39: He said: My Lord! Because Thou hast sent me astray, I verily shall adorn the path of error for them in the earth, and shall mislead them every one,
text.28:63: Those concerning whom the Word will have come true will say: Our Lord! These are they whom we led astray. We led them astray even as we ourselves were astray. We declare our innocence before Thee: us they never worshipped.
text.37:32: Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray.
text.38:82: He said: Then, by Thy might, I surely will beguile them every one,
